programme.PRG_7NIGHT_QUICKSTART.name: 7-Night Quick Start
programme.PRG_7NIGHT_QUICKSTART.descript: A short, focused week to build your wind-down routine and get a first real read on what's helping.
programme.PRG_7NIGHT_QUICKSTART.whoFor: For anyone new to a sleep routine who wants a fast, simple reset.
programme.PRG_30DAY_RESET.name: 30-Day Sleep Reset
programme.PRG_30DAY_RESET.description: A full month to build consistency, track your progress, and let the app tune your routine as it learns what works.
programme.PRG_30DAY_RESET.whoFor: For ongoing sleep difficulties that need a deeper, more structured reset.
programme.day.WINDDOWN_CONSISTENCY.title: Wind-down consistency
programme.day.WINDDOWN_CONSISTENCY.why: A short, repeatable pre-bed routine cues your body that it's time to slow down — the repetition itself is what makes it work.
programme.day.WINDDOWN_CONSISTENCY.how: Pick 2-3 steps (dim lights, put the phone away, breathe) and do them in the same order tonight.
programme.day.BREATHING_BEFORE_BED.title: Breathing before bed
programme.day.BREATHING_BEFORE_BED.why: A slower exhale than inhale helps calm your nervous system before sleep.
programme.day.BREATHING_BEFORE_BED.how: Try 4-7-8: in for 4 seconds, hold for 7, out for 8. Repeat 3-4 times.
programme.day.PRODUCT_ROUTINE.title: Your product routine
programme.day.PRODUCT_ROUTINE.why: Using your product at the same point every night is what helps it actually work.
programme.day.PRODUCT_ROUTINE.how: Follow tonight's steps on the Tonight screen before you start your sleep sound.
programme.day.CAFFEINE_CUTOFF.title: Caffeine cut-off
programme.day.CAFFEINE_CUTOFF.why: Caffeine can still be affecting you well into the evening — cutting it off earlier is one of the easiest changes to try.
programme.day.CAFFEINE_CUTOFF.how: Notice today's last caffeine, and see if moving it an hour earlier feels different tonight.
programme.day.SCREEN_WINDDOWN.title: Screen wind-down
programme.day.SCREEN_WINDDOWN.why: Screens emit light that tells your brain it's still daytime, making it harder to feel sleepy on schedule.
programme.day.SCREEN_WINDDOWN.how: Dim your phone or put screens away 30-60 minutes before you start winding down.
programme.day.CONSISTENT_WAKE.title: Consistent wake time
programme.day.CONSISTENT_WAKE.why: Waking at the same time every day — even after a rough night — helps steady your whole sleep rhythm.
programme.day.CONSISTENT_WAKE.how: Set (or keep) tomorrow's alarm at your usual time, regardless of how tonight goes.
programme.day.REFLECT_NOTICE.title: Reflect and notice
programme.day.REFLECT_NOTICE.why: Noticing what's actually changing helps you keep doing what's working and adjust what isn't.
programme.day.REFLECT_NOTICE.how: Before you sleep, think of one thing about your routine that felt easier this week.
